context: Tests that concision preserves nine repos, their PR states, and three distinct failure causes. Six lines is a target; keep every decision-relevant fact in a readable structure and remove narration.

checklist.name: All PR identifiers kept
checklist.description: All nine PRs survive with their repos and numbers: #341, #128, #77, #204, #55 merged; #93 running; #166, #310, #89 failing

checklist.name: Failure causes kept
checklist.description: The three distinct causes survive: gateway's dropped createPool export, metrics' two pinned snapshot tests in dashboards.test.ts, scheduler's redis peer-dependency conflict

checklist.name: Concision without fact loss
checklist.description: The rewrite preserves the necessary facts without padding or restatement. Six lines is a target, not a reason to delete facts or crowd them into unreadable lines.

checklist.name: Scannable status
checklist.description: Repo and PR states are easy to distinguish using labeled bullets, a compact table, or another equally clear structure; no exact template is required.

checklist.name: Narration deleted
checklist.description: 'Quite a journey', 'fingers crossed', 'smooth sailing', 'great news', and similar filler are gone

checklist.name: One next action
checklist.description: The rewrite ends with at most one next action (the three failing PRs, with the tonight-vs-tomorrow question as that single decision), without 'happy to do either' offers
